correctness.rationale: The unique degree-two component forces every projective stabilizer element to preserve the smooth conic. Exact restrictions distinguish one secant line from four tangent lines. The induced Möbius map must preserve the pair {0,infinity} and the pair {1,-1}, so it is one of t,-t,1/t,-1/t. Restriction to the conic is injective, and four explicit diagonal maps realize all four cases. The packaged verifier checks the defining polynomial, tangent/secant identities, parametrization, and the four induced maps exactly.
